items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: The interviewee responds to the interviewer's mention of 'The Sheik' by discussing the location and organizations, but does not indicate any personal relationship with a person named Sheik.

ctx.x: What's that one that's down below that you play for every year, down below the Industrial Canal? Industrial Canal. You know the church, where we go to church? The Masons, I think. The Sheik. Yes, indeed. She handles that fight. Usually handles it. They're belong students. Not funerals, but a Sunday. Dedication. A dedication it was on here. It's a parade. I think I missed it this year. Cornerstone Lane, I usually call it.
Well, you know, I'll tell you. There's no organizations down there, but you see, sometimes the organizations have an occasion to go down there to lay a stone.
